title: jsfl/runtime.ts: layer.keyframes should be layer.frames — production code bug
description: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts line 2207 uses 'layer.keyframes' which does not exist on the Layer type (Layer has 'frames', not 'keyframes'). TypeScript reports TS2551: Property 'keyframes' does not exist on type 'Layer'. Did you mean 'frames'? This is a PRODUCTION CODE BUG — any JSFL script that exercises this code path will hit a TypeError at runtime. Fix: change both occurrences of '.keyframes' at line 2207 to '.frames'.
